items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: By the way, Wardell Grey and Lucky Thompson also worked with that same band.

ctx.x: There is a lot of dust – and just about every biography of you, and some jazz encyclopedias, they talk about your work with territory bands. I want to mention one name, Jimmy Rashell.
Jimmy Rashell. I never worked with him, but I worked with Benny Carew. By the way, Wardell Grey and Lucky Thompson also worked with that same band.
The Carew band or the Rashell band?
